name: Greeny
source:
She's not like other girls. . . really.

Your name is JD. You're a tall, handsome, well-endowed, nineteen-year-old catholic school student and wouldn't you know it? Drama finds you. So you just broke it off with your girlfriend and already someone's caught your eye. Her name is Justine (she's also nineteen!) and quite a popular musician with a lot of promise. She has the hots for you, so don't play nice, but don't be a jerk! After all, there's something special about her, and it isn't just her green hair!

[From [url=https://alphajerk.itch.io/greeny]Itch.io[/url]]

她和其他女孩不一样。。。真的。

你的名字是JD。你是一个高大、英俊、天赋异禀的十九岁天主教学校学生，你难道不知道吗？戏剧找到你。所以你刚刚和你的女朋友分手，已经有人引起了你的注意。她的名字叫贾斯汀（她也十九岁了！），是一位很有前途的受欢迎的音乐家。她对你很感兴趣，所以不要表现得很好，但也不要表现得很混蛋！毕竟，她有一些特别之处，而不仅仅是她的绿发！
